en: A clean white postcard-style first day cover commemorating the Sydney 2000 Summer Olympic Games. At the bottom left is a graphic of the Sydney Opera House with the Olympic rings and the red and black text "Sydney 2000" followed by smaller Estonian text. At the top right there is an Estonian postage stamp featuring an athlete in motion over the Estonian flag colors and the word "Sydney 2000." Two circular first‑day postmarks read "TALLINN 05.09.2000" with the Olympic rings and Sydney 2000 logo.
